packageRules.description: A devDependency major gets its own pull request rather than joining the grouped non-major one. The bundler we develop against decides what our tree-shaking gate measures, and on 2026-09-06 vite sat a major behind every fixture lockfile without anything saying so; npm run compat:check now fails on that, and this is the other half — a proposal early, the gate late.
TS 6/7 blocked until ts-morph (public peer), tsup dts, and typescript-eslint support the new compiler
